interpretation: The same catalogue part number may have separate factory/supplier claims and vehicle cohorts; the same gap title may represent one unresolved task referenced from multiple datasets. Source-scope comparisons are recorded without deleting or rewriting original records.

Factory/support terminology for kit-for-prior-switch must not imply an equivalent full part or confirmed VIN fitment.
